scope.claim: Exact short scalar paths match independent snapshot and ordered chunk oracles
scope.flags: EAX and all general registers are checked; AF is omitted only for zero byte remainder, and DF must retain each supplied input value
scope.matrix: All lengths zero through thirty-one, four source word alignments, seven destination offsets, sixteen frame alignments and both direction flags
scope.memory_policy: Only four scalar code ranges are loaded; every byte or word access is checked, full payload and stack pages are compared, and no feature global or jump table is read
not_claimed: Any long-copy, REP, SIMD or feature-dispatch path
Wrapping or unmapped ranges, frame aliases or complete copy-library equivalence
Actual game execution or accounting promotion
premises: Nonwrapping mapped source and destination intervals within one writable payload page; overlapping ranges are allowed
Protected stack and exact scalar code are disjoint from payload storage
